title: Absolutely continuous curves in spaces of compactly supported densities
summary: We give a constructive proof for existence of absolutely continuous curves connecting each pair $μ,ν\in \mathrm{PL}_\infty^p(\mathbb{R}^n)$, for every $1\leq p\leq \infty$, where $(\mathrm{PL}_\infty^p(\mathbb{R}^n),\mathfrak{d}_\infty^p)$ is the complete metric space of absolutely continuous measures with density in $L^p(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and bounded support introduced in [1].
